messages:
Nina (Finance): FYI Im seeing three customers report "invoice mismatch" from batch_20260410_11. Looks like duplicates plus missing reserved-credit lines.

Omar (Billing Eng): Which batch and a sample invoice id so I can pull logs?

Nina (Finance): batch_20260410_11. Sample acct: Skylark (acct_id=70123). Two invoices issued: INV-70123-20260410 and INV-70123-20260410-b. The -b invoice is missing the reserved capacity credit rows (negative lines).

BillingBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.18 job_20260410_11_2 WARNING duplicate_invoice_detected acct=70123 reason=shard_split_negative_rows

Omar (Billing Eng): That reason matches a recent normalization change where credits are emitted as negative usage rows. If negative rows land in a different shard they don't merge and the generator creates a provisional invoice with only positives.

Jules (RevOps): Support already has tickets. Customers concerned about being billed twice. Recommend we pause auto-issue on reason=shard_split_negative_rows and scan the batch.

Priya (Acct Mgr): Finance, do we need explicit sign-off to void the provisional invoice and reissue consolidated one?

Nina (Finance): Approve void + credit memo + reissue for affected accounts in this batch. Net effect should be zero. Please include a customer-facing note and reconciliation CSV.

Omar (Billing Eng): Plan: run scanner for reason=shard_split_negative_rows (quick-check), dry-run remerge for affected accts, then apply: create credit memos for provisional invoices, mark them void, and emit reissued invoices with note "reissued due to billing shard split". Filing ticket BIL-9033 to gate auto-issue on this error.

BillingBot: [system] ticket created: BIL-9033 (hold auto-issue on shard_split_negative_rows).

Omar (Billing Eng): Quick scan result: 3 accounts affected (70123, 70210, 70888). Dry-run remerge looks good for all. Applying fixes for Skylark now and will attach recon CSV when done.

Priya (Acct Mgr): I'll prepare the customer note: short apology, confirmation net-zero impact, new invoice id.

Nina (Finance): Thanks. Keep thread updated and attach reconciliation when available.

BillingBot: [system] reconciliation_report uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/reports/2026-04-10/batch_20260410_11_recon_1878000000.csv
